lines.trans: Good evening Mathias, here I am at last!
So, is the shoot finished?
All good, it is in the can!
You achieved an incredible feat.
The team sends everything to editing.
What pride to see you here.
I wanted to be here tonight.
We celebrate thirty years of ASK.
This agency matters a lot to me.
You are always our favorite star.
Look at all these friends gathered.
We form a large united family.
Let's have a drink all together.
To our agency and to the future!

examples.text: Cette agence ne représente que des stars.

meanings.note: une agence artistique = a talent agency
with numbers: huit ans, vingt ans
je viens d'arriver = I've just arrived

examples.trans: The future of the agency is secure.
He is thinking about his future.

examples.text: Il y a un macaron sur la table.
examples.trans: There's a macaron on the table.

meanings.note: elle a quarante ans = she is forty

meanings.en: il y a = there is / there are

examples.trans: You know a lot of people.

meanings.en: beaucoup de = a lot of, many

examples.trans: Would you like something to drink?

meanings.note: as an interjection: bon, alors... = right, so...

meanings.en: bonne journée = have a nice day
good night (when leaving in the evening)

examples.text: Ouvre la boîte tout de suite.

meanings.note: before a noun: ce film, cette tête, ces gens
as a pronoun in c'est, ce n'est pas; becomes c' before a vowel

examples.text: Des gens comptent sur ce film.
examples.trans: People are counting on this film.

meanings.en: compter sur = to count on, to rely on

meanings.note: dans une heure = in an hour

examples.text: La plus grande imprésario de Paris.

meanings.en: as a noun: the whole, a set

examples.text: Terminer le tournage à temps est un exploit.
examples.trans: Finishing filming on time is a feat.

examples.text: C'est pour faire plaisir à ma famille.
examples.trans: It's to make my family happy.

meanings.en: pride, sense of dignity or achievement

examples.text: C'est une grande fierté pour nous.
examples.trans: It is a great pride for us.
I'm the one who trained you!

meanings.note: c'est moi qui t'ai formée = I'm the one who trained you

examples.text: On fête son anniversaire ce soir.
examples.trans: We are celebrating her birthday tonight.
You came! I can't believe it!

meanings.note: c'est incroyable! = I can't believe it! / it's amazing!
before the verb: vous la connaissez? les voilà
object pronoun before the verb: tu me donnes
with reflexive verbs: je me débrouille

examples.text: Nous devons assurer le montage du film.
examples.trans: We must secure the editing of the film.

examples.text: Je suis là pour voir Mathias.

meanings.note: also used as a noun: mon préféré = my favourite (one)

examples.trans: How old would you say she is?

meanings.en: se réunir = to meet, to convene

meanings.note: réussir à faire qc = to succeed in doing sth

examples.text: C'est notre seule chance de réussir!
examples.trans: It is our only chance to succeed!

examples.text: Je ne peux pas venir ce soir.

examples.trans: He's a star. / She's a star.
The stars are arriving in Cannes.

meanings.note: always feminine, even for a man: une star
before the verb; t' before a vowel

meanings.en: c'est terminé: it's over, it's done
meanings.note: past participle used as an adjective

examples.text: Le tournage commence dans trois semaines.

meanings.note: from tourner un film = to shoot a film

examples.text: Ça ne va pas du tout.

meanings.note: oui à tout = yes to everything
plural tous (pronounced 'tous' with s): merci à tous
before a noun: tout le monde = everyone
singular and informal: friends, family, children, colleagues of the same age

examples.text: Un verre d'eau, s'il vous plaît.

meanings.note: prendre un verre: to have a drink

voilà.gloss: there is; here's; there you go

meanings.note: + noun: je veux un café; + infinitive: je veux partir
place: à Paris, à mon cours

meanings.en: au = à + le, aux = à + les
